component.name: Tablet Mode
component.summary: Display zoom for convertibles in tablet mode

description.p: Settings for kohaku-tabletd, which switches between GNOME's display scale and a temporary zoom when a convertible folds into tablet mode or a shortcut is pressed.

ul.li: Choose the default scale (saved in GNOME) and the temporary zoom
See which programs triggered a switch, and block them
Get notified when a new release is out
